study type: Quasi-experimental pre-post intervention study with 2-year follow-up
exposure: Concentrated preterm formula (CPF) as a liquid human milk fortifier (HMF) (Similac Special Care 30 - SSC30)
Different fortification stages (CPF + HM 1:2 volume ratio, CPF + HM 1:1 volume ratio, powdered HMF + HM 1 packet in 25 cm3)
outcome: Daily enteral milk intake in the first 4 weeks of life
Percentages of fortification in HM-fed infants in the first 8 weeks after birth
Body weight growth (z-score) at term equivalent age
cohort: The study participants were 73 extremely low birth weight (ELBW) preterm infants (37 in Period-I, 36 in Period-II).
finding: Using a liquid concentrated preterm formula as an alternative human milk fortifier might be beneficial for extremely preterm infants, improving daily enteral milk intake, fortification percentages, body weight growth at term equivalent age, and neurodevelopment (language and motor performance) at 24 months old.
